## Global error workflow
v2 had **no** error workflow: a throw in any Code node killed the chat turn and the draft disappeared with the execution.

After importing both files, point the main workflow's **Settings -> Error Workflow** at this one:
```bash
python3 scripts/wire_workflows.py --from-api      # or a hand-written ids file
```
This workflow deliberately has no error workflow of its own, so a failure while recording a failure cannot loop.
